rationale: Address logical and implementation issues identified during pre-submission audit without replacing the original primary endpoint.

days_since_rain_audit.publisher_definition: Number of days since last rain event.
days_since_rain_audit.rule: No recoding. If any numeric value lies outside the documented [0,180] range, repaired effect analyses fail closed.

h3_hierarchy_repair.reason: Original frozen formula omitted the lower-order shoulder main effect while including rain_z:shoulder.
h3_hierarchy_repair.primary_formula: prop ~ rain_z * shoulder + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
h3_hierarchy_repair.sensitivity_formula: prop ~ rain_z + rain_z:shoulder + C(State) * C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
h3_hierarchy_repair.decision: Report corrected coefficient and retain H3 unsupported unless both direction and CI support the prespecified negative interaction. This repair cannot upgrade the original H3 retrospectively to a preregistered positive result.

active_pool_richness.label: reviewer-motivated mechanistic diagnostic
active_pool_richness.eligibility: complete 10-stop UnifiedProtocol runs, valid documented DaysSinceRain, >=8 valid temperature stops, plausible run mean temperature [-10,45] C, parseable SurveyDate
active_pool_richness.response: log1p(number of distinct positively calling species across the 10-stop run)
active_pool_richness.formula: log1p_pool ~ rain_z + temp_z + bs(doy, df=5, degree=3) + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
active_pool_richness.directional_expectation: beta_rain_z < 0 means more recent rain is associated with a larger active species pool
active_pool_richness.interpretation_boundary: This is acoustic participation richness, not local occupancy richness or demographic richness.

independence_residual.label: reviewer-motivated mechanistic diagnostic
independence_residual.eligibility: same complete 10-stop runs as active_pool_richness with >=2 species in the run pool
independence_residual.observed: fraction of the 10 stops containing >=2 positively calling species
independence_residual.species_marginals: for each species in a run, fraction of the 10 stops at which that species called
independence_residual.primary_formula: independence_residual ~ rain_z + temp_z + bs(doy, df=5, degree=3) + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
independence_residual.sensitivity_response: mean across species pairs of observed pairwise co-calling frequency minus p_i*p_j
independence_residual.sensitivity_formula: pair_covariance_mean ~ rain_z + temp_z + bs(doy, df=5, degree=3) + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z
independence_residual.interpretation: A rain coefficient near zero supports activation/marginal-frequency change without detectable restructuring of residual within-run co-calling association.
independence_residual.limitation: Plug-in marginal probabilities are estimated from the same 10 stops and this diagnostic is reviewer-motivated, not part of the original confirmatory family.
